Sandbox_DynamicEventsContent_ConvoyCrash: A wrecked military convoy with weapon and medical loot, guarded by soldier zombies. Requires the KI5 military vehicle mods; skipped automatically if they are not loaded.
Sandbox_DynamicEventsContent_ExampleEven: The template event shipped as a reference for making your own. Off by default; only useful for testing.
Sandbox_DynamicEventsContent_MilitaryAir: Two to three military supply crates with high-tier weapons and gear. Rare, with a long cooldown.
Sandbox_DynamicEventsContent_Humanitaria: Supply crates with food, seeds, water and basic tools.
Sandbox_DynamicEventsContent_SimpleHorde: A large horde of zombies scattered over a wide area. Rare, with a long cooldown.
Sandbox_DynamicEventsContent_CityRepopul: Spawns a wandering horde on a town's outskirts and draws it toward the centre, repopulating cleared-out areas. Edit the event file to set your town's coordinates.
